Reference confidential or personal material in its governed location rather than copying it into the log. Preserve rejected and deferred requests with the reason and condition for reconsideration. That evidence prevents the same unresolved idea from returning under a new message and being treated as a fresh emergency.

At engagement close, review more than the number of changes. Identify assumptions that failed repeatedly, where estimate variance arose, and how approval waiting affected delivery. Do not turn raw counts into a score of the customer or an individual stakeholder. Use the evidence to improve the next baseline, intake questions, contract template, estimate ranges, and automated checks. If the method becomes portfolio evidence, disclose only your verified role and the non-confidential process. Do not publish client identity, amounts, internal disagreements, or claimed savings without permission and a reproducible basis.

role-authority-interview.ja: 面談で役割の意思決定権を確かめる質問
role-authority-interview.en: Interview Questions That Reveal Real Decision Authority
role-authority-interview.ja_intro: 抽象的な「裁量がある」を、予算・人員・優先順位・品質・例外時の権限へ分解して確認します。
role-authority-interview.en_intro: Vague autonomy becomes testable when interviews clarify authority over budget, people, priorities, quality, and exceptions.
sections: 優先順位の決め方を聞く
回答の矛盾を確認する

ja: 面談では最初に、この役割が解決する事業課題を聞きます。求人票の職務一覧ではなく、なぜ今このポジションが必要で、六か月後に何が変わっていれば採用が成功なのかを確認します。新設、欠員補充、再編、成長投資では期待と制約が異なります。目的が複数ある場合は、最優先の一つと、今回は扱わない範囲を分けてもらいます。
目的は魅力的な標語ではなく、観測できる状態へ落とします。「変革を推進する」なら、対象業務、利用者、期限、現在の障害、意思決定が必要な論点を尋ねます。面談者の回答を会社の正式な約束とはみなさず、確認者と根拠を記録します。医療・法務・顧客データを扱う役割では、成果より先に守るべき責任と利用禁止範囲も確認します。
目的を聞いた後は、入社後に事業状況が変わった場合、誰が目的を更新し、役割範囲を再合意するかも確認します。目的だけが変わり権限や資源が据え置かれる状態を避けるためです。
en: Start by asking which business problem the role exists to solve. A list of responsibilities does not reveal whether the company is filling a vacancy, creating a new capability, repairing a failed initiative, or funding growth. Ask what should be observably different six months after the hire, who experiences the current problem, and why the position is being opened now. If several outcomes are named, request the primary outcome and the work that is explicitly outside the role. A clear purpose provides the reference point for every later question about authority, resources, and evaluation.

Translate attractive language into an operating condition. If the role will “lead transformation,” ask which process, users, deadline, present constraint, and unresolved decisions define that transformation. Treat an interviewer’s explanation as evidence to verify, not automatically as a binding company promise. Record who owns the answer and what document or operating practice supports it. For work involving medical, legal, financial, customer, or personal data, also ask which responsibilities and prohibited uses override delivery speed. Authority without a stated purpose and boundary can become unlimited accountability for a goal no one has defined.

ja: 最終決定者を尋ねるときは、単に上司の役職を聞かず、提案、推薦、承認、拒否、実行を分けます。最近の具体例を使い、役割本人、直属上司、経営会議、法務、顧客の誰がどの段階を担ったかを確認します。日常判断と例外判断で経路が変わる場合は、それぞれの承認条件と平均的な所要時間を聞きます。
承認者が多いこと自体を悪いと決めつけません。重要なのは、責任を負う人が決定へ影響できるか、停止時のエスカレーション先があるかです。RACI表がなくても、直近の価格変更、人員追加、品質例外などを例に説明してもらえば実態が見えます。回答が抽象的なら、入社後最初に権限表を合意することを条件として記録します。
承認経路には通常の順番だけでなく、期限までに決裁者が応答しない場合の扱いも必要です。自動承認とみなすのか、上位へ上げるのか、作業を止めるのかを具体化します。
en: When identifying final approvers, separate proposing, recommending, approving, rejecting, and executing. Asking only who the manager is hides the actual decision chain. Request a recent, non-confidential example and map what the role holder, line manager, executive group, legal team, finance team, or customer did at each stage. Ask separately about routine decisions and exceptions, because a person may control normal delivery while having no authority when budget, risk, or policy changes. Record approval thresholds and typical decision time, not merely the names of committees.

Multiple approvers are not automatically a defect. The important test is whether the person accountable for an outcome can influence the decision and has a defined escalation path when work stops. Even without a formal RACI chart, a concrete example such as a price change, additional hire, quality exception, or customer commitment can expose operating reality. If interviewers cannot describe the path, treat authority as unknown rather than assuming autonomy from the title. A reasonable joining condition may be to agree a decision map during the first month and review it after the role encounters a real exception.

ja: 予算権限は「予算を持つ」という表現を、金額、用途、期間、変更可能性へ分解します。年間枠を管理するだけなのか、配分を変更できるのか、新規支出を決められるのかを確認します。採用、外注、ツール、広告、研修など費目ごとに承認経路が違う場合があります。予算未確定なら、いつ誰が決めるかを尋ねます。
目標達成に必要な資源と権限が一致しているかを確認します。コスト削減の責任があっても契約変更権がない、売上責任があっても価格や広告を決められない場合は、成果条件が他者に依存します。金額を聞けない機密事情もあるため、具体額の開示を強要せず、裁量範囲、承認段階、予算凍結時の優先順位を確認します。
予算の未消化を使い切ることと、顧客価値を生む投資は同じではありません。支出後の効果確認と、期待を外れた投資を停止・縮小できる権限まで確認します。
en: Break “you will own the budget” into amount, purpose, period, and change rights. The role may monitor an annual envelope without being able to reallocate it, authorize new spending, or stop an existing commitment. Ask how approval differs for hiring, contractors, software, advertising, training, travel, and emergency work. If the next budget has not been approved, identify who decides it, when that decision occurs, and what the role can do in the meantime. Budget authority should be supported by an actual process rather than inferred from seniority.

Test whether the resources match the outcome. A person accountable for cost reduction may lack authority to renegotiate contracts; a revenue owner may be unable to set price, approve campaigns, or choose a channel. Those dependencies do not make the role unacceptable, but they change the evidence needed to judge performance. Respect legitimate confidentiality and do not demand a precise figure during an interview. The useful questions concern discretion, thresholds, reallocation rights, approval latency, and the priority rule when funding is frozen. Record unresolved resource assumptions in the offer decision instead of filling them with optimism.

ja: 人員責任は、直属人数だけでなく、採用、配置、目標設定、評価、報酬提案、育成、契約終了の権限に分けます。業務委託や兼務メンバーを含む場合は、指示できる時間と優先順位を誰が決めるかを確認します。「チームを率いる」が、実際には調整だけを意味することもあります。
成果責任を負うのに必要人数が未充足なら、採用計画、採用決裁、欠員中の縮小範囲を聞きます。個人情報を含む評価記録をどこで管理し、AIや別Productへ移さないかも重要です。人員が不足した場合に、長時間労働で吸収することを暗黙の前提にせず、目標、範囲、期限のどれを調整するか確認します。
人員責任には、心理的安全性や健康を損なう負荷を止める責任も含まれます。目標未達時に人を増やすだけでなく、不要業務の停止や役割再設計が選択肢にあるかを聞きます。
en: Decompose people responsibility beyond the number of direct reports. Ask who can recruit, select, allocate, set goals, review performance, recommend compensation, approve development, and end an assignment. Include contractors and shared team members: the role may coordinate their work while another manager controls their time and priorities. “Lead the team” can mean managerial authority, project facilitation, technical guidance, or merely responsibility for reporting. A concrete distinction protects both the candidate and future colleagues from an operating model based on an ambiguous verb.

If the required team is not staffed, ask about the hiring plan, approval owner, expected timing, and which deliverables will be reduced while vacancies remain. Do not accept overwork as the silent substitute for missing capacity; clarify whether goal, scope, sequence, or date changes when staffing falls below plan. For roles handling employee or candidate information, verify where performance records are stored, who may access them, and whether data is prohibited from external AI or unrelated products. People authority includes a duty to protect information and apply fair, reviewable processes, not only a right to assign tasks.

ja: 優先順位の決め方は、会議名ではなく判断基準を尋ねます。顧客影響、売上、法令、安全、復旧性、期限、学習価値が衝突したとき、何を上位に置くのかを具体例で確認します。役割本人が順序を決められる範囲と、上位方針へ戻す条件を分けます。
緊急案件が通常計画へ割り込む場合は、追加するだけでなく何を停止するかを聞きます。すべてが最優先という回答なら、実際の直近四半期に延期・中止した仕事を尋ねます。評価指標と優先順位が矛盾する場合もあります。短期件数を求めながら品質事故を厳しく罰するなら、どのGateで速度を止めるか確認します。
優先順位を変えた後、関係者へ何を伝え、どの計画や指標を更新するかも重要です。口頭の方針転換だけでは、現場に古い目標が残り二重責任が生じます。
en: Ask for the decision rule behind priority, not only the name of the planning meeting. Explore what happens when customer impact, revenue, law, safety, recoverability, deadline, and learning value conflict. Use a recent example to identify which criteria prevailed and why. Separate priorities the role can set from conditions that must return to an executive, risk owner, or customer. A role with genuine autonomy should have a visible method for resolving trade-offs, not simply the expectation that the individual will satisfy every stakeholder simultaneously.

When urgent work enters the plan, ask what is stopped, delayed, or reduced. If every initiative is described as the top priority, request an example of work postponed or cancelled during the last quarter. Also compare priority logic with performance measures. A company may demand short-term throughput while penalizing any quality incident, leaving the role to absorb an impossible contradiction. Ask which mechanical or human gate is allowed to slow delivery, who accepts the delay, and how the decision is recorded. Real authority includes permission to say not now when capacity or safety evidence requires it.

ja: 失敗時の責任は、結果だけでなく、当時確認できた情報と本人が制御できた範囲で判断されるかを聞きます。障害、顧客失注、予算超過、納期遅延の事例で、原因分析、報告、是正、再発防止を誰が担ったか確認します。失敗を隠さず早く止めた行動が評価されるかも重要です。
責任と処罰を混同しません。意思決定ログや事後検証がある組織では、結果が悪くても判断品質を学べます。反対に権限のない人だけが責任を負うなら構造的なリスクです。面談で完全な安全を約束させるのではなく、異論を述べる経路、重大事故の独立レビュー、報復を避ける仕組みを確認します。
失敗の学習が公開処罰にならない一方、重大な過失や隠蔽まで曖昧にしない境界も確認します。公正な調査、記録、再発防止、必要な是正を分けて扱えるかが重要です。
en: Ask whether failure is assessed only by outcome or also by the information available and factors the role could control. Use examples such as an outage, lost customer, budget overrun, missed date, or unsuccessful experiment. Identify who reported the event, contained harm, analyzed causes, approved corrective action, and verified prevention. Early stopping and transparent escalation should not be confused with poor performance. The answer reveals whether the organization expects responsible risk management or rewards silence until a problem becomes impossible to hide.

Accountability is not the same as punishment. Decision logs and blameless but rigorous reviews allow a company to learn even when an outcome is unfavorable. A structure that assigns responsibility to a person without giving access, resources, or authority creates predictable failure. The candidate does not need a promise that nothing will go wrong. More useful evidence is the route for raising disagreement, protection for good-faith escalation, independent review of serious incidents, and a method for separating system causes from individual misconduct. Ask how a recent lesson changed a process, test, or boundary.

ja: 評価指標は、指標名、測定方法、母数、期間、正本、更新頻度を確認します。売上、件数、満足度、品質の言葉だけでは、本人が何を改善すべきか分かりません。入社後三十・六十・九十日と一年で期待する状態を分け、短期の立ち上がりと長期成果を混同しないようにします。
指標を達成するための権限があるか、他部署依存をどう扱うかを同時に確認します。未整備の指標なら、誰が定義し、過去データを検証し、目標変更を承認するかを聞きます。架空の昇進率や成功率を求めず、実際の評価周期、フィードバック相手、異議申立て手順を確認します。入社後は最初の評価前に書面で再確認します。
評価指標が良く見えること自体を目的にすると、対象外の利用者や長期品質が犠牲になります。指標の副作用と、数字が改善しても目的を達成していない場合の見直し方法を尋ねます。
en: Verify each success measure through its definition, calculation, denominator, period, source of truth, and update frequency. Words such as revenue, volume, satisfaction, quality, and transformation do not tell a role holder what evidence matters. Separate expectations for thirty, sixty, and ninety days from the one-year outcome so onboarding is not judged as if the full operating system already existed. Ask which measures are leading indicators, which are final outcomes, and what minimum evidence is required before a reported improvement becomes a company claim.

Connect every measure to authority and dependency. If another department controls data, delivery, staffing, or customer access, ask how that constraint enters evaluation. When a metric is still being designed, identify who defines it, validates historical data, approves a changed target, and prevents retrospective movement of the goalposts. Do not ask interviewers to invent a promotion rate or success percentage. More reliable evidence is the review cycle, feedback participants, calibration method, and appeal path. Plan to reconfirm goals in writing before the first formal evaluation, especially when the role or team is new.

ja: 複数の面談者へ同じ中核質問を行い、回答の一致点と差分を記録します。目的、決裁、予算、人員、優先順位、評価について説明が違っても、直ちに不誠実と断定しません。役割が新しい、組織変更中、部門ごとに認識が違う可能性があります。差分を具体的な質問へ戻し、最終確認者を特定します。
矛盾が残る場合は、都合のよい説明を採用せず前提ログへ残します。どの回答が外れたとき結論が変わるかを確認し、重要ならオファー受諾前の確認条件にします。入社後も三十・六十・九十日に再検証し、役割記述と実態の差を上司と調整します。会社名や面談者の個人情報を外部AIへ渡して比較しません。
回答差分は受諾判断の材料であると同時に、入社後の最初の改善課題にもなります。ただし候補者が組織設計を一人で背負う前提にはせず、責任者と期限を置きます。
en: Ask the same core questions across interviewers and record agreements and differences about purpose, approval, budget, people, priorities, and evaluation. Inconsistent answers do not automatically prove dishonesty. The role may be new, the organization may be changing, or functions may genuinely operate with different assumptions. Convert each contradiction into a precise follow-up question and identify the person authorized to resolve it. This is more useful than asking whether the culture is collaborative and receiving several equally positive but non-comparable descriptions.

When a contradiction remains, do not select the answer you prefer. Keep it in an assumption log and test whether the offer decision changes under each plausible version. If it does, make resolution or a written operating agreement a condition of acceptance. Recheck the material assumptions at thirty, sixty, and ninety days after joining, then discuss gaps with the manager while evidence is still fresh. Preserve confidentiality: do not submit company names, interviewer identities, internal documents, or personal details to an external AI merely to compare answers. The durable asset is the verification method, not a public judgment about one employer.

portfolio-claim-verification.ja: ポートフォリオの実績主張を公開前に検証するチェック
portfolio-claim-verification.en: A Pre-Publication Verification Check for Portfolio Claims
portfolio-claim-verification.ja_intro: 公開実績は、帰属・測定期間・守秘義務・第三者の役割・再現条件を確認してから掲載します。
portfolio-claim-verification.en_intro: Portfolio claims need attribution, measurement boundaries, confidentiality review, and transfer conditions before publication.
sections: 成果の帰属を確認する
数字の出所を確認する

ja: ポートフォリオに書く文は、まず検証可能な事実主張、本人の解釈、将来への仮説に分けます。「売上を伸ばした」は事実主張であり、対象、期間、測定方法、比較基準が必要です。「顧客理解を深めた」は解釈なので、観察した行動や成果と混ぜません。読み手が一文だけ引用しても確度を誤解しないよう、断定の直後に根拠の範囲を置きます。
形容詞を増やして強く見せる代わりに、何を変え、何を観測し、何が未確認かを書きます。「大幅」「革新的」「圧倒的」といった語は、比較対象と根拠がなければ削除します。意見を残す場合は「私は〜と判断した」と主体を明示し、組織の公式見解や顧客評価のように見せません。主張の種類を分けるだけで、文章は短くても信頼性が上がります。
公開前レビューでは各文に「確認済み」「解釈」「推測」「非公開」の印を仮置きします。確認済み以外が成果見出しに残っていれば、表現を弱めるか証拠を追加します。この印は公開ページに表示するためではなく、執筆者とレビュー担当者が同じ基準で判断するための作業記録です。判断が割れた文は公開せず、根拠保有者と再確認します。
en: Classify every portfolio sentence as a verifiable claim, personal interpretation, or forward-looking hypothesis. “Increased revenue” is a factual claim and needs a defined subject, period, measurement method, and comparison point. “Improved customer understanding” is an interpretation unless it is tied to observable behavior or evidence. Place the evidence boundary immediately after the claim so that a reader—or an AI system quoting one sentence—does not mistake a limited observation for a universal result.

Replace promotional adjectives with the change made, the observation recorded, and the remaining uncertainty. Words such as dramatic, innovative, or industry-leading should be removed when no explicit comparator supports them. If interpretation is useful, identify its owner: “I concluded…” is different from an official company finding or a customer endorsement. Separating claim types produces writing that is both more credible and easier to review, even when the final paragraph is shorter.

Before publication, temporarily label each sentence confirmed, interpretation, inference, or confidential. If an unconfirmed sentence remains in the achievement headline, either narrow the wording or add evidence. These labels are internal review aids, not public badges. They give the author and reviewer a shared decision rule. When classification is disputed, hold the sentence and return to the evidence owner instead of resolving uncertainty through stronger copy.

ja: 成果の帰属は、本人が担当した作業、共同で行った作業、他者が決定・実行した作業に分解します。プロジェクト全体の数字を、その一部を担当した個人の成果として書きません。提案、承認、実装、運用、分析の各段階で自分が何を担ったかを示し、最終成果との因果関係が確認できない場合は「寄与した」「支援した」と範囲を限定します。
役割を小さく見せないことと、全成果を自分のものにしないことは両立します。例えば、意思決定に使われた分析を設計したなら、分析の目的、採用された判断材料、本人が管理した品質基準を具体化できます。一方、経営判断や販売実行をしていないなら、その権限まで主張しません。本人の価値は、権限を誇張せずとも意思決定への接続を示せます。
帰属確認には、当時の役割記述、承認履歴、成果物の版管理、会議記録などを使います。ただし機密資料を個人端末や公開リポジトリへ移しません。証拠の所在、確認者、確認日だけを安全な記録へ残し、公開時は組織名や顧客名を必要な範囲で匿名化します。証拠を保有できない場合は、確認可能な範囲まで表現を縮めます。
en: Decompose attribution into work performed personally, work performed jointly, and decisions or execution owned by others. Do not convert a project-wide result into an individual achievement merely because the person participated in one stage. State the role across proposal, approval, implementation, operation, and analysis. When causal contribution cannot be isolated, use bounded language such as contributed to or supported rather than claiming sole ownership of the final outcome.

Accurate attribution does not require understating the person’s value. If an analysis informed a decision, describe the decision question, the evidence designed, and the quality controls personally owned. If executives made the decision and another team executed it, do not claim their authority or delivery. The portfolio can still show how the author’s work changed the quality, speed, or traceability of the decision without appropriating the organization’s total result.

Use role descriptions, approval history, version control, and meeting records to verify attribution, but never move confidential material into a personal device or public repository. Record only the evidence location, authorized verifier, and verification date in a safe review log. Anonymize organizations and customers where required. If evidence cannot be retained or checked, narrow the public wording to what an authorized reviewer can actually confirm.

ja: 数字を掲載する前に、元データ、計算式、集計条件、更新日を確認します。ダッシュボードに表示された値だけでは、分母、除外条件、重複処理が分かりません。売上、工数、転換率、件数などは、どのシステムのどの定義を使ったかを記録します。再計算できない数字は、正確な実績ではなく当時の概算として明示するか、公開から外します。
割合は分子だけでなく分母を残します。「エラーを半減」は、対象件数、観測期間、比較期間、エラー定義が揃って初めて意味を持ちます。母数が小さい場合や季節要因がある場合は、その制約を数字の近くに書きます。小数点以下の精密さで信頼感を演出せず、データの精度に合った丸め方を選びます。
第三者が算出した数字を使う場合は、本人が検証した範囲を明記します。社内レポートの数値を転記しただけなら「社内集計による」とし、自分が測定したとは書きません。公開許可と計算妥当性は別の確認です。出してよい数字でも定義が曖昧なら掲載せず、定義が明確でも機密なら公開しません。
en: Before publishing a number, identify its source data, formula, inclusion rules, and last update. A dashboard value alone does not reveal the denominator, exclusions, deduplication, or corrections behind it. For revenue, workload, conversion, and volume claims, record the system and metric definition used. If the result cannot be reproduced, label it as a contemporaneous estimate with an appropriate range or omit it instead of presenting false precision.

A percentage needs its numerator and denominator. “Cut errors by half” becomes meaningful only when the population, observation period, comparison period, and error definition are stable. Place small-sample or seasonal limitations beside the number rather than hiding them in a general disclaimer. Choose rounding that matches the data quality. Extra decimal places do not create evidence and can make an uncertain estimate appear more authoritative than it is.

When another team calculated the metric, state what the portfolio author actually verified. If the number was copied from an authorized internal report, attribute it to that report rather than implying personal measurement. Permission to disclose and validity of calculation are separate gates. A permissible number with an unclear definition should not be published, and a well-defined number that is confidential must remain private.

ja: 測定期間は開始日と終了日だけでなく、比較対象が同じ条件だったかを確認します。導入前後で商品構成、担当人数、営業時間、広告費が変われば、単純比較では施策の効果を分離できません。因果を断定できない場合は「同期間に観測した」と書き、施策だけが原因だったとは述べません。
母数は対象全体と分析対象を分けます。欠損、重複、テストデータ、途中離脱を除外したなら、除外理由と件数を安全な範囲で記録します。好結果だけが残る選別を防ぐため、集計条件は結果を見る前に固定します。条件を後から変えた場合は変更理由と両方の結果をレビュー記録に残します。
時点の異なる数字を一つの成果として合成しません。月次値、累計値、単年度値を区別し、更新されたデータで結論が変わる可能性を示します。公開後も参照されるページにはデータ時点と見直し日を付けます。古い数字が現在値として引用されない構造は、AIOと読者保護の両方に必要です。
en: Verify not only the start and end dates but whether the comparison periods were operationally comparable. Changes in product mix, staffing, hours, price, or advertising can prevent a simple before-and-after comparison from isolating the effect of one intervention. When causality is not established, say that the outcome was observed during the same period rather than claiming the intervention alone produced it.

Separate the total population from the analyzed sample. If missing records, duplicates, tests, or incomplete cases were excluded, preserve the reason and count within the permitted disclosure boundary. Fix inclusion rules before examining the outcome to reduce selection bias. If the rule changed afterward, record why and retain both results in the review evidence instead of showing only the more favorable version.

Do not combine monthly, cumulative, and annual values into a single achievement. Identify the measurement date and whether later data could change the conclusion. Public pages that may be cited over time need both a data-as-of date and a scheduled review date. This structure helps readers and AI systems avoid repeating an old observation as a current fact.

ja: 共同成果では、意思決定者、実装担当、運用担当、レビュー担当の役割を簡潔に書きます。全員の氏名を公開する必要はありませんが、本人だけで完結したように見せないことが重要です。外部ベンダーや顧客側担当者が主要部分を担った場合も、契約と守秘の範囲で役割を示します。
第三者の発言を推薦文として使う場合は、本人の同意、掲載範囲、肩書き、確認日を確認します。雑談や社内チャットの一文を、許可なく顧客の評価として公開しません。匿名化しても文脈から特定できる場合があるため、匿名化だけを許可の代わりにしません。
チーム成果の中で自分の判断を示すには、選択した基準、反対案、リスク、承認経路を記述します。他者の貢献を明示しても本人の思考は伝わります。むしろ協働条件を説明できる方が、別の組織で再現できる能力として評価しやすくなります。
en: For collaborative outcomes, identify the decision owner, implementers, operators, and reviewers at a useful level of abstraction. Individual names are rarely necessary, but the story must not imply that one person completed the entire effort. If a vendor or customer-side team owned a substantial component, acknowledge that role within contractual and confidentiality limits.

Treat testimonials as separately permissioned content. Confirm the speaker’s consent, approved wording, title, publication context, and review date. Do not turn an informal conversation or internal message into a public endorsement. Anonymization does not replace consent when the surrounding facts can identify the person or organization.

Show individual judgment inside team delivery by explaining the criteria selected, alternatives considered, risks raised, and approval route followed. Crediting others does not erase personal contribution. It often makes the work more transferable because a future employer can see how the person collaborates, escalates, and produces decisions under real organizational constraints.

ja: 公開許可は「機密情報を消したから大丈夫」と推測せず、契約、就業規則、顧客合意、著作権、個人情報の扱いを確認します。退職後も守秘義務が続く場合があります。判断できない場合は、権限を持つ担当者や法務へ確認し、回答がない状態を許可済みにしません。
画面画像、資料、コード、ロゴ、顧客名は文章とは別に確認します。自分が作成した成果物でも、著作権や公開権限が会社・顧客にある場合があります。画面をぼかすだけで内部構造や数値が推測できるなら掲載しません。代わりに、公開用に作り直した架空データの図と、実案件ではない旨を明記します。
医療、金融、法務、広告に関する成果は、一般的なポートフォリオより厳しい確認を行います。患者、顧客、取引、決済、契約のデータを持ち出さず、効果効能や適法性を本人の判断だけで断定しません。公開できないことは弱点ではなく、境界を守った上で方法と判断基準を説明します。
en: Do not infer permission from successful redaction. Check contracts, employment rules, customer agreements, copyright ownership, and personal-data obligations. Confidentiality may continue after employment ends. When authority is unclear, ask an authorized owner or legal reviewer and keep the material unpublished until the answer is documented.

Review screenshots, documents, code, logos, and customer names separately from the narrative. Work created personally may still be owned or controlled by an employer or customer. Blurring a screen is insufficient when structure or values remain inferable. Prefer a newly created demonstration using clearly labeled fictional data when that accurately explains the method without reproducing protected material.

Apply stricter review to medical, financial, legal, and advertising work. Never move patient, customer, transaction, payment, or contract data into a portfolio or external AI system. Do not make efficacy or compliance claims based only on the author’s opinion. When the underlying case cannot be disclosed, explain the method, decision criteria, and safety boundary rather than treating confidentiality as a weakness.

ja: 再現条件は、別の環境で同じ数字が出るという約束ではありません。必要なデータ品質、権限、予算、人員、期間、経営判断を示し、どの条件が欠けると方法が機能しないかを書きます。成果だけでなく、適用可能な範囲と停止条件を説明します。
本人の持ち運べる能力と、前職固有の資産を分けます。分析設計、検証手順、関係者調整は移転可能でも、ブランド、顧客基盤、独自データ、既存システムは持ち運べません。次の職場で再現できるのは方法の一部であり、同じ成果値ではないことを明示します。
反証条件も書きます。データ欠損率が高い、決裁者が不在、対象者が異なるなど、結論を再評価すべき条件を示します。成功事例を万能な処方箋にせず、どの場面で使わないかを説明できることが、実務能力と信頼性の証拠になります。
en: Transfer conditions do not promise that another organization will reproduce the same number. Identify the required data quality, authority, budget, staffing, time, and management decisions, and state which missing conditions would make the method unsuitable. Explain applicability and stop conditions alongside the outcome.

Separate portable capability from assets that belonged to the original organization. Analytical design, validation practice, and stakeholder coordination may transfer; brand strength, customer relationships, proprietary data, and existing systems do not. The portfolio should claim a reusable method, not a guaranteed replication of the prior result.

Include falsification conditions. High missing-data rates, absent decision owners, or a materially different population may require the conclusion to be withdrawn. A strong case study explains where the approach should not be used. That boundary is evidence of operational judgment and is more credible than presenting one successful context as a universal prescription.

ja: 公開ページには、実績の対象期間、データ時点、本文の最終確認日を分けて表示します。記事の更新日だけを変え、数字や根拠を再確認していない状態を避けます。レビュー時には、リンク、肩書き、組織名、公開許可、計算定義が現在も有効かを確認します。
訂正履歴は、誤りを隠すためではなく信頼を保つために残します。重要な数字や帰属を変更した場合は、変更日と理由を簡潔に示します。軽微な表記修正まで大量に列挙する必要はありませんが、結論に影響する変更は読者が追跡できるようにします。
更新責任者と次回確認日を決めます。担当者が離れた場合や証拠へアクセスできなくなった場合は、検証済み表示を外すかページを非公開候補にします。古い成功談を永続的な現在実績として残さず、確認可能性が失われた時点で表現を見直します。
en: Display the achievement period, data-as-of date, and last substantive review date separately. Avoid changing an article’s update date when the numbers and evidence were not rechecked. A review should confirm that links, titles, organization descriptions, disclosure permission, and metric definitions remain valid.

Keep a correction history for material changes. When a number, attribution, or conclusion changes, state the date and reason briefly. Minor typography does not need a public ledger, but changes that alter the reader’s understanding should remain traceable. Correction is a reliability practice, not an admission that the entire portfolio is untrustworthy.

Assign an owner and next review date. If the owner leaves or evidence access is lost, remove the verified status or place the page in an unpublished review state. A historical success should not remain framed as a current fact forever. Revising the claim when verifiability disappears protects both the subject and future readers.
